Thanks again for the quick responses on the POC. Our execs are only available in a narrow window next week and asked if we can do a 30-minute technical demo (focused on inference latency & VPC options).

Preferred dates: Sep 22 or Sep 23. Preferred times (Pacific time):
- Option 1: 08:00–08:30 PDT (early morning)
- Option 2: 18:00–18:30 PDT (late evening)

A couple notes:
- We have APAC presence (Rajiv) who may hop in depending on which slot we pick.
- We understand this will land at awkward times for the EU engineering team — if you can confirm who would host/record, that helps.

Can you confirm availability and whether either slot works for your EU engineers in CEST, and if the upcoming DST window (end of October) affects anything we should lock in now?

Appreciate the help — Samira

Hi Samira — thanks for the clear windows. Short answer: we can make a 30-minute slot work, but it will require either an evening host in the EU or a recorded session with a live Q&A follow-up. A couple practical notes and proposals: 

1) Quick timezone conversion (this week, PDT = UTC-7, CEST = UTC+2, SGT = UTC+8):
   - Option 1 (08:00–08:30 PDT) => 17:00–17:30 CEST / 00:00–00:30 SGT (next day)
   - Option 2 (18:00–18:30 PDT) => 03:00–03:30 CEST (next day) / 10:00–10:30 SGT (next day)

   As you can see, Option 2 pushes the EU team into the middle of the night (03:00 CEST) while Option 1 is late afternoon for EU and midnight for APAC.

2) We have two operational approaches that customers typically pick:
   A) Host live with EU engineers (rotate to an evening shift) — requires a volunteer EU host (Jonas can take a couple late evenings per quarter) and we record for APAC.
   B) Host live with US team & record — Redwood provides a follow-up technical Q&A the next morning with EU engineers on standby.

Proposed concrete slots (we'll lock in with calendar invites):
- Slot A (best for EU attendance): Sep 22, 17:00–17:30 CEST (08:00–08:30 PDT) — EU friendly, APAC at midnight
- Slot B (minimizes APAC disruption): Sep 22, 10:00–10:30 SGT (18:00–18:30 PDT, 03:00–03:30 CEST) — EU painful
- Slot C (compromise): Sep 23, 16:00–16:30 CEST (07:00–07:30 PDT, 23:00–23:30 SGT) — EU late afternoon, US early morning, APAC late night

3) DST note: Europe transitions back one hour in late October; since your demo is in September, current conversions above are stable. If you plan multi-week follow-ups in November, let's schedule in UTC to avoid surprises. We've attached a quick timezone_matrix_q3.ods showing the conversions and a one-page mutual_action_plan_v1.pdf that SKU teams wire up.

If you want I can create calendar invites for Slot A and Slot C and you can pick which to accept — or tell us which you prefer and we'll send the accepted invite.

Thanks — Kim

--
Kimberly Park

Kim / team — thanks for the fast turnaround and the conversions, super helpful. Our execs prefer Option 1 (early morning PDT) because it keeps their day clear. That maps to your Slot A (17:00 CEST on Sep 22). Two asks: 

1) Can Jonas or another EU engineer host? If not possible, we'll take a US-hosted session but need a 20-minute live Q&A with EU engineers the following morning CEST.
2) Could you include a recording + short write-up of the network/KMS architecture you show? That helps our security folks.

If both are possible we'll accept Slot A: Sep 22 at 08:00 PDT.

—Jason
